Account.title: Account Ledger
Account.description: An individual General Ledger account title used in the double-entry sheets

name.description: Human-readable label name of the ledger

isSystem.description: Flag preventing deletion of system default accounts

JournalEntry.title: Journal Transaction Entry
JournalEntry.description: A single balanced physical double-entry transaction record

date.description: Standard calendar ISO representation of entry posting date

debitAccount.description: Target Ledger Account ID to debit

creditAccount.description: Source Ledger Account ID to credit

amount.description: Total transfer quantity represented in INR

files.description: Optional attached receipts or files (base64 encoded)

SheetMetadata.title: Ledger Sheet Details Profile
SheetMetadata.description: General settings profile for titles, captions, and treasurer signatures

allowedEmails.description: Array of 3 authorized editor email addresses

Student.title: Student Dues Record
Student.description: A ledger record tracking active student union fee contributions and balances

id.description: Unique registration ID or roll number

lastPaymentDate.description: ISO date of the last fee submission

Program.title: Student Union Program Folder
Program.description: A program folder (e.g., Ramadan, Fest) tracking guest/student dues for each student of the class

studentDues.description: Map from Student ID to dues item: amountPaid, totalDue, status, remarks

/programs/{programId}.description: Individual programs folders tracking specialized student dues

/students/{studentId}.description: Student dues database synchronized with cloud Firestore

/accounts/{accountId}.description: General Ledger accounts list synchronized with remote Firestore cluster

/entries/{entryId}.description: Physically validated double entry journal items

/metadata/{configId}.description: Metadata settings for the general ledger sheets

/file_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Base64 text content parts split to stay under the 1MB Firestore document limit
